target.title: Fix Homebrew cask updater detection
target.body:
Fixes #10
## Summary

Fixes Homebrew cask install detection so Sparkle stays disabled when Nameplate is installed through Homebrew but the app bundle lives at `/Applications/Nameplate.app`.

Modern Homebrew casks can place the app directly in `/Applications`, so checking only whether the bundle path contains `/Caskroom/` can miss Homebrew-managed installs. This keeps the existing legacy Caskroom path detection and also checks the standard Homebrew cask receipt locations:

- `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/nameplate`
- `/usr/local/Caskroom/nameplate`

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- `swift build`

Focused behavior proof:

```text
PROOF modern-app-with-receipt=true
PROOF modern-app-without-receipt=false
PROOF old-caskroom-path=true
```
